fields.description: Parents can simulate mobile money payments from the portal. Turn this off in production.
fields.label: Enable Demo Payments

fields.description: Weights of the five parts must add up to 100. Each part is scored 0-1 for the current term.
fields.label: Risk Score

fields.description: Absent counts fully, Late half, Excused not at all; full at 30% of days
fields.label: Weight: Attendance

fields.description: Minor 1, Moderate 2, Serious 4 points; full at 8 points
fields.label: Weight: Discipline

fields.description: Subjects graded F; full at 3
fields.label: Weight: Failed Subjects

fields.description: Drop of the term average against the previous term; full at 10 points
fields.label: Weight: Decline

fields.description: An average at or above this adds nothing
fields.label: Low Average Below

fields.description: Low is below this score
fields.label: Medium From

fields.description: Marks that may need a second look. Alerts are a warning only: they never block saving or publishing.
fields.label: Marks Alerts

fields.description: Turns the statistical checks on or off. Integrity checks (changes after publishing, entries by unassigned users, unpublishing) always run.
fields.label: Enable Statistical Checks

fields.description: Class checks skip a subject with fewer submitted marks than this
fields.label: Minimum Class Size

fields.description: Share of the class with exactly the same mark (0 and full marks not counted)
fields.label: Identical Marks From (%)

fields.description: Share of the class with 0
fields.label: Zero Marks From (%)

fields.description: Share of raw marks that are multiples of 5 (0 and full marks not counted); about 20% is normal
fields.label: Round Numbers From (%)

fields.description: Standard deviation of the percentages below this raises an alert; 0 turns the check off
fields.label: Minimum Spread (percentage points)

fields.description: Earlier exams of the subject at the same Form needed before the class average is compared
fields.label: History: Minimum Exams

fields.description: Robust z-score (median / MAD) of the class average against its history
fields.label: Class Average: z Above

fields.description: Robust z-score of a student's change against the class's median change
fields.label: Student Change: z Above

fields.description: And the student's change differs from the class's by at least this many percentage points
fields.label: Student Change: Minimum Points

fields.description: And the class average differs from the usual average by at least this many percentage points
fields.label: Class Average: Minimum Points
